panels.description: Per-turn phase latency. The selected Grafana time range is applied to session close time, matching report_recent_sessions.py.

targets.rawSql: WITH selected_sessions AS (SELECT session_id FROM (SELECT session_id, max(closed_at_ms) AS closed_at_ms FROM pipeline.session_summaries GROUP BY session_id HAVING max(pipeline.session_summaries.closed_at_ms) BETWEEN $__from AND $__to)), turn_latency AS (SELECT * FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'turn.latency' AND status = 'ok' AND session_id IN (SELECT session_id FROM selected_sessions)) SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Time to first audio' AS Phase, avgIf(vad_endpoint_to_first_audio_ms, isNotNull(vad_endpoint_to_first_audio_ms)) AS Average, quantileIf(0.50)(vad_endpoint_to_first_audio_ms, isNotNull(vad_endpoint_to_first_audio_ms)) AS p50, quantileIf(0.95)(vad_endpoint_to_first_audio_ms, isNotNull(vad_endpoint_to_first_audio_ms)) AS p95, countIf(isNotNull(vad_endpoint_to_first_audio_ms)) AS Turns FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'STT', avgIf(stt_endpoint_to_final_ms, isNotNull(stt_endpoint_to_final_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(stt_endpoint_to_final_ms, isNotNull(stt_endpoint_to_final_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(stt_endpoint_to_final_ms, isNotNull(stt_endpoint_to_final_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(stt_endpoint_to_final_ms)) FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'LLM Queue', avgIf(llm_queue_ms, isNotNull(llm_queue_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(llm_queue_ms, isNotNull(llm_queue_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(llm_queue_ms, isNotNull(llm_queue_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(llm_queue_ms)) FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'LLM Encode', avgIf(llm_encode_ms, isNotNull(llm_encode_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(llm_encode_ms, isNotNull(llm_encode_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(llm_encode_ms, isNotNull(llm_encode_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(llm_encode_ms)) FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'LLM Decode', avgIf(llm_decode_ms, isNotNull(llm_decode_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(llm_decode_ms, isNotNull(llm_decode_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(llm_decode_ms, isNotNull(llm_decode_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(llm_decode_ms)) FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'Phrase Generation', avgIf(phrase_generation_ms, isNotNull(phrase_generation_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(phrase_generation_ms, isNotNull(phrase_generation_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(phrase_generation_ms, isNotNull(phrase_generation_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(phrase_generation_ms)) FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'TTS Queue', avgIf(tts_queue_ms, isNotNull(tts_queue_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(tts_queue_ms, isNotNull(tts_queue_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(tts_queue_ms, isNotNull(tts_queue_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(tts_queue_ms)) FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'TTS First PCM', avgIf(tts_first_pcm_ms, isNotNull(tts_first_pcm_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(tts_first_pcm_ms, isNotNull(tts_first_pcm_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(tts_first_pcm_ms, isNotNull(tts_first_pcm_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(tts_first_pcm_ms)) FROM turn_latency UNION ALL SELECT 'Media Edge Queue', avgIf(media_edge_queue_ms, isNotNull(media_edge_queue_ms)), quantileIf(0.50)(media_edge_queue_ms, isNotNull(media_edge_queue_ms)), quantileIf(0.95)(media_edge_queue_ms, isNotNull(media_edge_queue_ms)), countIf(isNotNull(media_edge_queue_ms)) FROM turn_latency) ORDER BY multiIf(Phase = 'Time to first audio', 1, Phase = 'STT', 2, Phase = 'LLM Queue', 3, Phase = 'LLM Encode', 4, Phase = 'LLM Decode', 5, Phase = 'Phrase Generation', 6, Phase = 'TTS Queue', 7, Phase = 'TTS First PCM', 8, 9)
